meta.title: Vehicle Universe - every kind of vehicle from cycles to rockets
meta.snapshot: Compiled mid-2026 from general knowledge; prices approximate, converted to USD at ~2025 rates

field_notes.market_status: In production | In service | In service (production ended) | Discontinued | Retired | In development | Operational | Completed mission | Historical
field_notes.available_new_today: true only when market_status is 'In production' (can be bought new)
field_notes.launch_price_usd: Nominal price at first launch (not inflation-adjusted); null when unknown
field_notes.current_price_usd: Approx. current starting price in USD; null when not sold new
field_notes.reference_price_usd: Latest known base / unit price (list, contract or estimate) regardless of status
field_notes.data_confidence: High | Medium | Low - Low means estimate, verify before relying on it
field_notes.logo.image_url / image_url / model_3d.gl: Empty on purpose - add your own licensed assets; UI falls back to monogram / illustration / procedural 3D model

sources.curated: Original Vehicle Universe dataset (prices, status, specs)
sources.images: Wikimedia Commons (free licences, credited per image)
sources.spreadsheets: Vehicle Brands & Models spreadsheets (Wikidata export, Sept 2026) supplied by the site owner

vehicle_types.name: Bicycle / Tricycle

vehicle_types.name: Carriage / Wagon / Sled

vehicle_types.name: Snowmobile

vehicle_types.name: Combine Harvester
vehicle_types.description: Combine Harvester: agriculture vehicles in the land domain, powered by diesel ice, used for reaping, threshing, and winnowing.

vehicle_types.name: Armored Personnel Carrier
vehicle_types.description: Armored Personnel Carrier: military vehicles in the land domain, powered by diesel ice, used for troop transport in hostile zones.

vehicle_types.name: Subway / Metro

vehicle_types.name: Streetcar / Light Rail
vehicle_types.description: Streetcar / Light Rail: urban transit vehicles in the rail domain, powered by electric (overhead catenary), used for city surface transit.

vehicle_types.name: Freight Locomotive
vehicle_types.description: Freight Locomotive: heavy rail vehicles in the rail domain, powered by diesel-electric, used for massive overland cargo transport.

vehicle_types.name: High-Speed Passenger Train
vehicle_types.description: High-Speed Passenger Train: high-speed vehicles in the rail domain, powered by electric / magnetic levitation, used for rapid intercity travel (150+ mph).

vehicle_types.name: Canoe / Kayak / Rowboat
vehicle_types.description: Canoe / Kayak / Rowboat: human-powered vehicles in the water domain, powered by human kinematic, used for recreation, shallow water navigation.

vehicle_types.name: Sailboat / Windsurf
vehicle_types.description: Sailboat / Windsurf: wind-powered vehicles in the water domain, powered by wind energy, used for recreation, traditional navigation.

vehicle_types.name: Personal Watercraft (Jet Ski)
vehicle_types.description: Personal Watercraft (Jet Ski): personal motorized vehicles in the water domain, powered by ice (water jet pump), used for high-speed aquatic recreation.

vehicle_types.name: Motorboat / Speedboat
vehicle_types.description: Motorboat / Speedboat: commercial light vehicles in the water domain, powered by outboard / inboard ice, used for short-range aquatic transport.

vehicle_types.name: Tugboat
vehicle_types.description: Tugboat: commercial light vehicles in the water domain, powered by heavy diesel ice, used for towing and guiding massive ships.

vehicle_types.name: Passenger Ferry / Hovercraft
vehicle_types.description: Passenger Ferry / Hovercraft: mass transit vehicles in the water domain, powered by diesel / gas turbine, used for crossing rivers, straits, and bays.

vehicle_types.name: Container Ship
vehicle_types.description: Container Ship: heavy logistics vehicles in the water domain, powered by heavy fuel oil (marine diesel), used for intercontinental bulk cargo.

vehicle_types.name: Oil / Chemical Tanker
vehicle_types.description: Oil / Chemical Tanker: heavy logistics vehicles in the water domain, powered by heavy fuel oil (marine diesel), used for intercontinental liquid energy transit.

vehicle_types.name: Fishing Trawler
vehicle_types.description: Fishing Trawler: heavy logistics vehicles in the water domain, powered by diesel ice, used for commercial deep-sea harvesting.

vehicle_types.name: Cruise Ship
vehicle_types.description: Cruise Ship: passenger luxury vehicles in the water domain, powered by diesel-electric / lng, used for floating resorts, tourism.

vehicle_types.name: Aircraft Carrier
vehicle_types.description: Aircraft Carrier: military vehicles in the water domain, powered by nuclear fission, used for mobile maritime airbase.

vehicle_types.name: Submarine (Attack/Ballistic)
vehicle_types.description: Submarine (Attack/Ballistic): military vehicles in the water domain, powered by nuclear fission / diesel-electric, used for covert underwater operations.

vehicle_types.name: Hot Air Balloon / Blimp
vehicle_types.description: Hot Air Balloon / Blimp: lighter-than-air vehicles in the air domain, powered by propane burner / helium, used for tourism, aerial observation.

vehicle_types.name: Glider / Paraglider
vehicle_types.description: Glider / Paraglider: unpowered vehicles in the air domain, powered by gravity / thermal drafts, used for recreational flight, sports.

vehicle_types.name: Helicopter
vehicle_types.description: Helicopter: rotorcraft vehicles in the air domain, powered by turboshaft, used for vertical takeoff/landing (vtol) transit.

vehicle_types.name: Drone / UAV (Quadcopter)
vehicle_types.description: Drone / UAV (Quadcopter): rotorcraft vehicles in the air domain, powered by electric battery, used for aerial photography, light delivery.

vehicle_types.name: General Aviation (Cessna)
vehicle_types.description: General Aviation (Cessna): fixed-wing vehicles in the air domain, powered by piston ice, used for private transport, flight training.

vehicle_types.name: Business / Private Jet
vehicle_types.description: Business / Private Jet: fixed-wing vehicles in the air domain, powered by turbofan, used for high-speed corporate transit.

vehicle_types.name: Commercial Airliner
vehicle_types.description: Commercial Airliner: fixed-wing vehicles in the air domain, powered by turbofan, used for global mass passenger transit.

vehicle_types.name: Heavy Cargo Aircraft
vehicle_types.description: Heavy Cargo Aircraft: fixed-wing vehicles in the air domain, powered by turbofan, used for intercontinental rapid freight.

vehicle_types.name: Fighter Jet
vehicle_types.description: Fighter Jet: military vehicles in the air domain, powered by low-bypass turbofan (afterburning), used for supersonic air superiority.

vehicle_types.name: Stealth Bomber / AWACS
vehicle_types.description: Stealth Bomber / AWACS: military vehicles in the air domain, powered by turbofan, used for strategic payloads, reconnaissance.

vehicle_types.name: Suborbital Rocket
vehicle_types.description: Suborbital Rocket: aerospace vehicles in the space domain, powered by solid / liquid propellant, used for brief zero-gravity flights, research.

vehicle_types.name: Orbital Launch Vehicle
vehicle_types.description: Orbital Launch Vehicle: aerospace vehicles in the space domain, powered by liquid oxygen / kerosene / methane, used for deploying satellites to earth orbit.

vehicle_types.name: Space Shuttle / Spaceplane
vehicle_types.description: Space Shuttle / Spaceplane: aerospace vehicles in the space domain, powered by liquid h/o + solid boosters, used for reusable orbital crew/cargo transport.

vehicle_types.name: Lunar / Mars Rover
vehicle_types.description: Lunar / Mars Rover: extraterrestrial vehicles in the space domain, powered by solar / radioisotope thermoelectric, used for planetary surface exploration.

vehicle_types.name: Space Capsule
vehicle_types.description: Space Capsule: extraterrestrial vehicles in the space domain, powered by thrusters (hypergolic), used for crew transport to orbital stations.
